_note: Provided-model manifest for the Caldera build (specs/assets.md). 'dimensions' are the model extents [width, height, depth] and are the on-field relative-scale contract. 'kind' is 'rigid' (parts posed on named joints) or 'static' (a single mesh, no rig). 'clips' maps a game role to the animation clip name to play. 'accent' is the reserved color the recolor tables below act on: it appears nowhere else on that model, so remapping it repaints only the plates/trim/fittings and leaves the body and the acid glow untouched. A destroyed Slag is not animated - it breaks apart or fades and is removed (specs/enemies.md), so there is no death clip. Per-model 'parts'/'joints' lists are added with each model as its asset case lands.

tiers._note: Slag tier accents (specs/enemies.md). The accent is authored in a visibly distinct color so the asset case's own reviewer can see the region; Tier I paints it down to the true obsidian body, so one code path serves every tier. Keyed by the Slag accent color.

towerLevels._note: Tower upgrade accents (specs/towers.md). Level 0 maps the accent onto brass-dark, so an unupgraded tower reads as authored. Keyed by the Holdfast accent color.

pipeFluids._note: The pipe kit is authored in a neutral base color and recolored per network (specs/fluids.md).

slag._note: One model per archetype; three tiers are produced by the 'tiers' recolor, never by new geometry. Each 'dimensions' triple is that asset case's base [voxel] volume, so the four archetypes' on-field sizes stay in the proportions their cases were sculpted at. Proportion alone tells them apart: the Runner is low and long, the Sapper tall and thin, the Breaker wide and top-heavy, the Colossus massive.

towers._note: One model per tower; two upgrade levels above base are produced by the 'towerLevels' recolor. The Scald's field is continuous, so it runs 'emit' as a loop rather than firing discrete shots.

structures._note: The Core plays a one-shot 'upgrade' on purchase and carries the Holdfast accent across its four upgrade levels. A Boiler plays 'boil' only while fed water; a Pump plays 'pump' only while delivering.

pipes._note: Static geometry, no rig and no clips. The build owns topology, orientation, the stretch across a terraced edge, the raised river trestle, and the animated flow (specs/assets.md).
